description: Geografische Areaalregistratie Metrering vaarwegen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. In deze laag worden dijkpalen en (fictieve) vaarwegkilometreringen op basis van de vaarwegas opgenomen. De vaarwegkilometrering wordt gebruikt voor plaatsbepaling van objecten en ter orientatie. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, GML, GeoPackage, JSON, PNG. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
